title: Train to Stitch: Topology-Preserving Regularization for Interoperable Representations
abstract: arXiv:2610.19401v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large, powerful pre-trained models become more prevalent, there is growing interest in developing methods that allow different neural networks to be seamlessly combined with little or no direct communication between them. Take autoencoder-based data compression as an example: the ability to independently choose architectures and train encoder and decoder models, while still ensuring they work together, could fundamentally transform how such models are built, deployed, and updated. In this work, we introduce a novel approach that leverages topological regularization to align the latent spaces of two independently trained autoencoder models, entirely eliminating the need for coordination during training. We provide a conditional theoretical analysis showing how the structural agreement encouraged by our regularizer can translate into approximate geometric compatibility between independently learned representations. translated_title: 训练即缝合：面向可互操作表示的拓扑保持正则化方法
translated_abstract: 随着大型且功能强大的预训练模型日益普及，人们越来越关注开发能够让不同神经网络无缝结合的方法，且这些网络之间几乎不需要或完全不需要直接通信。以基于自编码器的数据压缩为例：能够独立选择架构并分别训练编码器和解码器模型，同时仍确保它们能够协同工作，这将从根本上改变此类模型的构建、部署和更新方式。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，利用拓扑正则化来对齐两个独立训练的自编码器模型的潜在空间，完全消除了训练过程中协调配合的需要。我们提供了条件性的理论分析，展示了我们的正则化器所促进的结构一致性如何能够转化为独立学习的表示之间的近似几何兼容性。重建实验……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种拓扑保持正则化方法，无需训练期间的任何协调即可对齐独立训练的自编码器的潜在空间，从而实现表示层面的互操作性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a topology-preserving regularization method that aligns the latent spaces of independently trained autoencoders without any coordination during training, enabling interoperable representations.
